result.summary: Independently re-verified ISS-0829's fix on commit c4d3f257, does not merely echo TEST-RUNNER's report. (1) Targeted mix test test/letflow/platform/migration_rollout_test.exs: 12 passed, 0 failures. (2) Independent TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 scripts/test_parallel.sh, launched as a true backgrounded OS process and polled (no bare blocking call, no cross-turn Monitor wait): partition 1: 1172 tests/0 failures; partition 2: 1281 tests/2 failures (exit 2); partition 3: 1328 tests/0 failures; partition 4: 1227 tests/0 failures. Combined: 5008 tests, 6 properties, 2 failures (5012/5014 passed). Both failures are Letflow.IdentityTest 'resolve_tenant_by_realm/1 and resolve_realm_by_tenant/1 (REQ-019 acceptance criterion 1)' -- structurally confirmed via `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- test/letflow/identity_test.exs lib/letflow/identity.ex` returning empty (zero lines) -- this branch's diff never touches either file, so these are genuinely pre-existing/unrelated, matching TEST-RUNNER's own incidental flag. TEST-RUNNER's separately-flagged Letflow.EventStore.RetentionOperationsTest failure did NOT reproduce in this independent run (expected -- a different, non-deterministic failure set under contention, consistent with a parallel-suite flake rather than a new regression); `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- test/letflow/event_store/retention_operations_test.exs lib/letflow/event_store/retention_operations.ex` also returns empty, confirming it too would be structurally unrelated if it had reproduced. Neither incidental finding was investigated or fixed in this run (out of scope). (3) Also independently ran `mix letflow.check.test` (the separate, stricter ISS-0069 gate) as its own true backgrounded+polled process: exited 1 on its own fresh N=16-partition run, same combined 5012/5014 (2 failures), same two Letflow.IdentityTest REQ-019 AC1 tests, zero occurrences of the fixed substring 'default values for the optional arguments' anywhere in any partition log (grepped the full raw output directly, not trusting a truncated tail) -- so the ISS-0069 anti-pattern this task specifically guards against is NOT present; the exit 1 is attributable entirely to the same pre-existing IdentityTest race. (4) Read EO-004 and EO-005's actual current test bodies in test/letflow/platform/migration_rollout_test.exs (lines 334-477): EO-004 asserts a real status transition (poisoned company's outcome flips failed->succeeded with reason cleared and a real completed_at, verified via a direct Repo.get! reload, not just the returned summary map), asserts the already-succeeded company's outcome is byte-identical before/after (status, completed_at, reason all via direct equality per design doc section 8), and asserts the rollout's own completion status structurally matches its outcome set rather than a hardcoded literal (explicitly reasoned in-comment for a concurrently-swept-in tenant). EO-005 asserts zero writes scoped to its own rollout_id+tenant_ids (outcome_count before/after equality via a scoped query, completed_at unchanged, rollout row unchanged via direct struct equality), with explicit in-comment reasoning for why counts are scoped rather than global. Neither test is weakened into an always-pass shape -- both assert on real DB-reloaded state and real status transitions.
